newsitem.title: USA: Ameritech confirms sale of Polish stake.
newsitem.headline: Ameritech confirms sale of Polish stake.

text.p: Ameritech Corp on Thursday said it has sold its 24.5 percent stake in the Polish cellular telephone firm Centertel SA.

"Our expectations are that the agreement relative to Poland will be completed tomorrow," Richard Notebaert, chairman and chief executive, told Reuters after a meeting with reporters. Ameritech said its stake was sold to Poland's state-owned telecom firm TPSA and France Telecom Mobile International.
Prior to the sale, the two owned 51 percent and 24.5 percent, respectively.

Notebaert said Ameritech had done well in Poland, but there was a disagreement over seeking a license to develop a modern digital GSM (Global System for Mobile Communications) system for Centertel, which now operates an older analog system. Newspapers in Poland also said there were conflicts over power and profit sharing.
"We just had a disagreement over their willingness to fulfill their obligations in GSM," Notebaert said.
Notebaert said Ameritech has not disclosed how much it will receive for the sale, but newspapers there have reported they bought their stake for $36 million and have sold it for about $50 million.
